title: Mä Divina Señal uñjiri
intro: Mä qollan santuario manqhanjja, mä bendicionat almaw Diosan uñjatajj uywatäna. Aka jaqix mä milagro ukan mä jach’a lurawimp phuqhañapänwa, Allah-an jan tukuskir ch’amapampi yatiñapampix mä testamento ukhamaw tukuwayi. Jupanakan saräwipax mä jach’a chiqawj uñacht’ayäna, ch’amjam amuyunaka ukat taqpach jaqinakatakix mä sapa chimpuw utt’ayasïna.
clues: Nayax Allah-an ajllitätwa ukat q’umachatarakiwa, taqi warminakat sipansa, nayan pachajanxa.
Mä cheqapar sarnaqer profetan uñjatajaruw uchapjjetäna, jupajj oración lurañ utajan mä milagrompiw manqʼañanak churapjjetäna.
Familiajat sapakiw mä sapa chiqar Allah yupaychañatak sarawayta.
Mä angelaw mä jan juchani jaqir uñtat uñstawayitu, mä qʼuma yuqall wawat yatiyañataki, janis mä chachar uñtʼkchiyätxa.
Wawañan tʼaqhesiñanak qhepatjja, machaq manqʼañanak jikjjatañatakejj palmera qoqan troncop chʼalljjtayañaw sasaw sapjjetäna.
Jichhak yurir wawajar aptʼataw markajar kuttʼanjjayäta ukhajja, jisktʼapjjetäna, ukampis jiskʼa wawajajj mä milagro toqew cunat arjjatañatakejj arsüna.

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Mä jach’a uma jalsu, ukax mä jan iyawsir markaruw t’unjäna
Idolonakar jan iyawsatapat nina nakhaskir ninar jaquntatäña
Mä milagro tuqi jan awkini wawax yurïwipa
Mä misión jaytatapat mä ballenampi manqʼantatäña
trial.answer: Mä milagro tuqi jan awkini wawax yurïwipa

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Mä thujru, ukax mä katariruw tukuwayi

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Mä wawax awk taykapar arxatañatakiw cunat arsüna
Jaqinakar irpañatakix mä divin libron qhanañchäwipa
outcome.answer: Mä wawax awk taykapar arxatañatakiw cunat arsüna

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
